A coordinated wartime command
focuses.why_player_wants_it: An organised national war effort provides an immediate fighting and mobilisation dividend.

focuses.role: Prepare a decisive regular offensive
focuses.why_player_wants_it: A player seeking a battlefield breakthrough gets more usable military production, cohesion and experienced staff.
focuses.description: Concentrate the next staff, reserve-equipment and training allocation on a regular offensive. The main force gains the cohesion needed for a decisive campaign, while its supply commitment grows. Negotiations and local defence continue alongside this priority.

focuses.role: Sustain protracted pressure
focuses.why_player_wants_it: A player protecting scarce equipment gets an economical defensive army and a cheaper doctrinal adaptation.
focuses.description: Concentrate the next staff and training allocation on staying power, protected routes and territorial defence. The army can sustain pressure with fewer supply demands, while a rapid offensive receives less planning attention. This course does not close the negotiating channel.

focuses.role: Standardise the main force
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Weapons standardisation supports actual rearmament and conversion of the wartime production base.

focuses.role: Sustain a negotiating position
focuses.why_player_wants_it: A calmer and less wasteful administration can maintain Paris contacts while the war continues.

focuses.role: Turn congress targets into administrative orders
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Better planning coordination raises the speed at which existing production lines reach useful efficiency.

focuses.role: Concentrate on heavy industrial capacity
focuses.why_player_wants_it: A weapons-producing country gets a materially higher industrial ceiling rather than another political-power coupon.
focuses.description: Reserve the next industrial allocation for machine-building, armament workshops and the technical knowledge needed to sustain them. More of the scarce capital stays in heavy production, leaving less for immediate agricultural improvement.

focuses.role: Rebuild civilian reproduction
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Food productivity and a broader reconstruction programme make a long recovery viable.
focuses.description: Direct the next reconstruction allocation towards food production and civilian works. Recovery must be visible in fields and ordinary workshops, even though the same investment cannot simultaneously expand the military production programme.

focuses.role: Deliver the existing paid industrial-combine project
focuses.why_player_wants_it: The useful reward is its real queued civilian factory; this catalogue adds no free instant factory or redundant percentage surcharge.

focuses.role: Expand food and consumer workshops
focuses.why_player_wants_it: The civilian route gains productive food supply and practical local reconstruction capacity.

focuses.role: Create a workable integration service
focuses.why_player_wants_it: A less costly administration and a credible civil settlement help govern the actual postwar territory.

focuses.role: Coordinate rapid enterprise transformation
focuses.why_player_wants_it: The state-enterprise route develops a higher and faster-reached industrial production ceiling.

focuses.role: Protect the transition's food base
focuses.why_player_wants_it: A gradual route keeps productive households and social cooperation available during integration.

focuses.role: Train collective enterprise managers
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Management education and an industrial research grant turn collective ownership into practical production capability.

focuses.role: Reward household initiative
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Household production contributes meaningful food output without abandoning wider state coordination.

focuses.role: Consolidate a national reconstruction programme
focuses.why_player_wants_it: The capstone combines a continuing administrative saving with one useful industrial research opportunity.

focuses.role: Audit the inherited plan
focuses.why_player_wants_it: A serious planning review provides usable industrial knowledge immediately rather than paying only for permission to hold a meeting.

focuses.role: Repair procurement discipline
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Reliable purchasing and delivery help agriculture and existing factories without pretending that party planning excludes expertise.

focuses.role: Authorise provincial experiments
focuses.why_player_wants_it: A pilot-led route improves actual project delivery and the conversion of experiments into production practice.

focuses.role: Organise the procurement service
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Food procurement becomes productive and administratively cheaper rather than merely imposing a larger target.

focuses.role: Fund provincial technical inquiries
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Local findings yield production improvements and a concrete construction-research grant.

focuses.role: Publish a usable congress programme
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Comparable accounts and technical documentation support government delivery and research collaboration.

focuses.role: Guarantee essential supplies
focuses.why_player_wants_it: A funded consumption floor protects food production and cooperation during reform.

focuses.role: Give enterprises operating room
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Retained operational authority offers substantial efficiency growth and a higher production ceiling.

focuses.role: Make ration guarantees deliverable
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Reliable distribution helps both households and the army instead of offering an abstract stability point.

focuses.role: Restore meaningful production accounts
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Selective price reform rewards productive firms while retaining the actual stabilisation decision.

focuses.why_player_wants_it: Cadre review cuts administrative waste and gets agreed projects delivered.

focuses.role: Prepare district implementation cadres
focuses.why_player_wants_it: A district-focused party education budget makes nationwide policy easier to carry out.

focuses.role: Build the specialist planning staff
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Party-based technical economists improve research connections and enterprise planning.

focuses.role: Staff effective district administrations
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Party schools train managers, administrators and technical cadres: lower bureaucracy and stronger delivery are the practical prize.
focuses.description: District officials must be able to turn a national programme into budgets, supplies and working enterprises. Assign the next training allocation to practical administration and industrial management in the Party school network, while the specialist advisory staff receives no matching expansion.

focuses.role: Commission a specialist production review
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Economist consultation produces an equally desirable industrial ceiling, output package and electronics-research opportunity.
focuses.description: The plan needs a specialist staff able to trace shortages through accounts, transport and prices. Assign the next training allocation to an economic and technical review team, while district Party schools continue without an equivalent expansion.

focuses.role: Transfer institutional knowledge
focuses.why_player_wants_it: The outgoing team hands over useful administrative records and technical relationships rather than another small power modifier.

focuses.role: Launch party-led renovation pilots
focuses.why_player_wants_it: The opening programme improves existing industry and grants a real industrial research opportunity.

focuses.role: Use household production contracts
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Households deliver a strong food-productivity gain and a more responsive supply economy.
focuses.description: Direct the next agrarian renovation allocation towards household delivery contracts, accountable purchasing and the right to retain additional surplus. Cooperatives may still provide services, but this programme puts the new administrative effort behind household responsibility.

focuses.role: Modernise cooperative production
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Cooperatives combine food output with shared reconstruction and service capacity.
focuses.description: Direct the next agrarian renovation allocation towards shared equipment, technical staff and cooperative infrastructure. Household production continues, but the new funding strengthens common services and collective management rather than enlarging the household-contract programme.

focuses.role: Connect rural markets to production
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Market access funds a useful industrial learning step and productive local workshops.

focuses.role: Equip the cooperative network
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Tools and credit raise agricultural output and the ability to use existing productive capacity.

focuses.role: Establish enterprise accounts

focuses.role: Sequence reform around a social floor
focuses.why_player_wants_it: A managed transition preserves consent and the technical capability to keep reforming.

focuses.role: Remove unproductive blanket protection
focuses.why_player_wants_it: A faster adjustment releases military-industrial output and efficiency headroom at a modest cohesion cost.

focuses.why_player_wants_it: A credible budgeted guarantee protects the social legitimacy needed for the next reform stage.

focuses.role: Repair fiscal and enterprise discipline
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Better accounts save administration and restore productive operating decisions.

focuses.role: Expose obstruction and implementation failures
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Public criticism supports less protected bureaucracy and faster circulation of technical information.

focuses.role: Coordinate reform through the party network
focuses.why_player_wants_it: The disciplined implementation route gains substantial production performance without pretending political uniformity is a research policy. Capital-policy training remains independent of the constitutional choice.

focuses.role: Negotiate independent civic organisation
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Independent scrutiny and expert association offer a genuinely different research and administrative package. Capital-policy training remains independent of the constitutional choice.

focuses.role: Screen foreign projects for domestic industry
focuses.why_player_wants_it: A selective opening develops local industrial output and a higher productive ceiling.
focuses.description: Screen projects against the machinery, repairs and operating needs of domestic enterprises. Investment can proceed under continued Party rule; the question is how to use limited administrative capacity, not whether political pluralism is required for foreign capital.

focuses.role: Make investment access credible
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Clear access rules support a strong construction programme and practical enterprise learning.
focuses.description: Develop predictable approvals, project infrastructure and operating guarantees for investment partnerships. State oversight remains in place, while the programme commits more of the investment administration to supporting wider commercial access.

focuses.role: Preserve renovation through external disruption
focuses.why_player_wants_it: The programme retains project delivery and research connections when old patron arrangements change.

focuses.role: Turn experiments into deliveries
focuses.why_player_wants_it: An implementation-focused opening immediately improves projects and existing production.

focuses.role: Delegate accountable provincial initiative
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Local discretion means cheaper administration and faster delivery, not simply decentralisation as a label.

focuses.role: Concentrate a national pilot programme
focuses.why_player_wants_it: The alternative coordinates major links and infrastructure across provincial boundaries.

focuses.role: Get food and goods into the cities
focuses.why_player_wants_it: A practical distribution network strengthens food production and the use of industrial capacity.

focuses.role: Create a project-delivery service
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Qualified managers make committed projects administratively cheaper and productive operations less wasteful.

focuses.role: Build the existing funded power project
focuses.why_player_wants_it: The paid, queued power plant is the substantive reward; no instant building or artificial percentage is added.

focuses.role: Let enterprises retain operating earnings
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Retained earnings fund faster enterprise investment and reduce central processing, at the cost of current corporate-tax collection.
focuses.description: Allow enterprises to reinvest a larger share of operating earnings and remove unnecessary central processing. Their investment programme can move faster, but current tax receipts fall as more resources remain inside the firms.

focuses.role: Concentrate public capital on priority projects
focuses.why_player_wants_it: The public-project route can deliver a stronger transport and construction backbone.
focuses.description: Pool the next development allocation in the national treasury for coordinated infrastructure and priority works. Central direction can connect projects that individual enterprises cannot finance, at the expense of additional administration.

focuses.role: Deliver the existing local-supplier factory project
focuses.why_player_wants_it: A real funded industrial-complex queue develops the supplier network without a free instant plant.

focuses.role: Deliver the existing northern road project
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Actual queued infrastructure is the useful reward and still consumes native time and construction capacity.

focuses.role: Name responsible managers for results
focuses.why_player_wants_it: Responsibility saves public administration and stops productive capacity being trapped below its potential.

focuses.role: Learn from export production
focuses.why_player_wants_it: The export route develops industrial output and technical learning without automatically creating an export treaty.

focuses.role: Deepen domestic supply chains
focuses.why_player_wants_it: The domestic alternative offers a stronger operating-efficiency base and less dependence on external sales.

focuses.role: Train production managers

campaigns.why_player_wants_it: 20 immediately usable Army XP and a 25% land doctrine discount make studying the long war worth a full focus, without requiring an ongoing war.

A lasting 3% organization and one percentage point of reinforce chance help the army maintain links between regional and regular commands. Southern party support remains a separate native action, not free equipment.
Schools retain a permanent training benefit, give finite Army XP, and provide a real 25% research bonus applicable to MD special forces equipment technologies including the 1975 and 1985 advances.
Regional links now produce a durable 4% organization and two percentage points of reinforcement chance. Decentralization slightly limits maximum planning.
A real continuing staff school: 10% lower land doctrine XP cost, 8% shorter army training and 5% division recovery rate, financed through the education budget.
Integrating the movement and regular army yields 20 Army XP and a 25% doctrine discount, as well as the real operational choice. It does not conjure southern units.
8% core defence and 8% division recovery rate reward attritional defence; the small planning penalty is a meaningful opportunity cost.
8% maximum planning and 5% initiative make deliberate main force operations attractive for only 2% extra supply consumption.
A useful final endurance plan: 10% core defence and division recovery rate, without a national military factory penalty.
10% planning and 8% initiative support a genuinely prepared offensive; 3% supply cost is smaller and more plausible than the current 6% surcharge.
A real completed campaign produces 25 Army XP and a 25% land doctrine discount. It is a finite lesson, never a renewable experience source.

Rights and predictable local administration improve the stability contribution by five points and agricultural productivity by 5%. Both are lasting institutional gains rather than six month emergency claims.
A limited, supervised security deployment yields 4% army organization and two percentage points of reinforcement chance, with an explicit operating budget.
An improved settlement provides six stability points and 8% agricultural productivity for a 2% social budget cost. It replaces the initial guarantees instead of adding another spirit.
More capable accountable screening strengthens army cohesion by 5% and reinforcement chance by three points. Its cost stays visible, and it cannot automatically settle political grievances.
A genuinely reached local settlement reduces disruption: 15% building repair and 5% corporate tax income provide a real economic reason to conclude it.
A standing reserve provides 8% shorter training and two reinforcement points while peace lasts; the expense is a genuine readiness cost.
Return to civil production gives 8% farm productivity and 10% repair speed rather than an ambiguous signed growth multiplier.
A final rotating reserve offers 4% organization and three reinforce points for a modest administrative cost.
Veteran reintegration becomes a lasting 10% agricultural and 15% repair programme, with an explicit social cost and small training tradeoff.
Recording the whole campaign produces 20 finite Army XP and a 25% special forces equipment research bonus for technologies that actually exist in MD.
The end of the long war gives 20 Army XP and two 25% doctrine discounts. The final focus is useful even if the player already has access to a review decision.
A concrete 10 Army XP and 20% doctrine planning discount accompany access to the border channel. These are staff preparation, not invented experience from a war that never happened.
The prepared southwestern defence offers 10% defence against CBD for a full operating year, with a modest command budget.
A two year relief effort supplies four stability points and 10% repair speed for a 1.5% social spending increase. It offers a real domestic reason to protect civilians.
A permanent earned staff plan activates 12% CBD defence and 4% attack during war; an operating year is useful and the 1.5% supply cost is restrained.
A lasting national logistics organization saves 5% supply at a 1.5% administrative cost. The bilateral commission remains a genuine recipient-owned diplomatic offer.
Formulating a real combined military and civilian plan gives 15 Army XP and a 20% doctrine discount. The mandate review does not itself declare war or dictate Cambodian government.
Limited objectives give a strong 14% defence against CBD and one entrenchment level, with only a 2% planning tradeoff. A real negotiated border dividend is available after settlement.
A 10% attack/4% defence plan and the existing native puppet war goal make intervention a worthwhile military option, with 2.5% extra supply rather than a free victory.
An accepted monitored border yields 10% CBD defence and a small supply saving, so diplomacy has a useful security payoff even when peace is maintained.
Preserve the already substantial 14% attack and 6% defence offensive package. Preparation before war makes its 240 day operating term usable during an actual short campaign.
Preserve the actual victory reward: 25 Army XP and two 20% doctrine discounts. This is a real success payoff rather than a buff for merely controlling the capital.
A genuinely secured southwest provides a lasting 8% agricultural and 4% supply saving dividend for a 2% liaison cost.
Direct administration has a tangible 10 point lower resistance target and 20% repair capability, paid for with a 2.5% administrative and 2% supply burden.
A real partner training mission gives 15 one-time Army XP, 5% division recovery rate and a 15% discount on Vietnam outgoing native military programme costs.
A costly dry season deployment is useful: 20% less resistance damage to garrisons and 10% repair capability. It does not delete guerrillas or claim the civilian costs of coercion are only economic.
Auditing and consolidating a real continuing commitment saves 3% national supply use and 2% of the bureaucracy cost component. The review now does something concrete.
Staying supplies a strong occupation package: 20% lower garrison damage and ten points lower resistance target, at a controlled but persistent operating cost.
Completed physical withdrawal earns a two year 5% supply saving and 5% agricultural productivity programme, offset by a modest 2% army organization transition cost.
Civil restoration offers 25% national repair speed and 10% compliance gain in qualifying occupied non core territory, with an explicit relief budget.
A verified final drawdown upgrades recovery to 6% lower supply use and 8% agricultural productivity for two years, replacing the earlier transition card.
An actual regional process provides an earned 10% repair and 5% construction recovery package. Opening a conference invitation does not pretend that neighbours accepted.
The final regional settlement upgrades recovery to 15% repair and 7% construction, plus a finite 25% doctrine lesson about limited commitments.
Northern frontier staff work yields15 useful Army XP and a20% doctrine discount rather than an almost empty channel unlock.
A genuine commission supplies a lasting5% construction and corporate tax factor for1% liaison expenses.
Preserve exact1 entrenchment and10% digging speed, make the funded preparedness useful for a year and accessible before war.
Fair citizenship and predictable property administration give five stability points and5% corporate tax income for1.5% bureaucracy expenses.
Preserve exactly2 entrenchment,15% digging speed and3% core defence for a useful year without a supply penalty.
A northern emergency staff plan gives20 Army XP and a25% doctrine discount; it should not lock useful plans until a short war is already over.
campaigns.label: Approve Frontier Plans
campaigns.description: A frontier confrontation may leave little time for deliberation. Agree the command arrangements and political limits before the crisis begins, so that prepared defensive or counteroffensive plans can be used when a real war demands them.
